info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: IrayatIrati . IreH kzepe viBAzA RO lukIrte gatikampayoH ' (Slo. 153) iti devaH .

examples: 'paSavo vE pUzA. ta etasya prasave prerate' (Sa॰brA॰9.2.3.12). prasavo'ByanujYAnam.  aByanujYAtAH santaH pracarantItyarTaH.
'yasya te viSvA BuvanAni ketunA pra cerate ni ca viSante aktuBiH' (f॰10.37.9). ketunA ca prerate gatimanti Bavanti pracaranti saYcarantItyarTaH. niviSante=uparamanti, niScalAni Bavanti.
'tvayyudite prerate citraBAno' (aTarva॰4.25\3). prerate sve sve karmaRi pravartante.
'kimuddiSya kASyapena matsakASamfzayaH preritAH syuH' (SA॰4). preritAH visfzwAH.
'AtmAnamapi ca krudDaH prerayed yamasAdanam' (BA॰vana॰29.6). anantarodita evArTaH.
'pra viprARAM matayo vAca Irate' (f0 9.85.7). vAcaH stutIH prerate prerayantItyarTaH.
'tAvimO SokasantApO SanEH preraya BAmini' (rA0 4.21.9). preraya apanaya apanuda vigamaya.
'te hocurdevAH. mlAno'yaM pitA mayoBUH. punarimaM samIryotTApayAmeti' (go॰brA॰u॰4.12). samIrya=vIjayitvA.
'sa EkzvAko'DAvayat, brAhmaRakumAraM raTena vyacCinat… tametena sAmnA samErayat' (paYca0 brA0 13.3.12). samErayat saNgatAvayavamakarot.
'kaSyapastvAmasfjata kaSyapastvA samErayat' (aTarva0 8.5.14). tvAM maRim. uktapUrva evArTaH.
'yAnevEzAM tasminsaMgrAme'GnaMstAn pitfyajYena samErayanta' (Sa0 brA0 2.6.1.1). samErayanta samajIvayan.
'kUpopakaRWe viSrAnto brAhmaRastayA samprerya kUpAntaH pAtitaH' (paYcata0). samprerya=praRudya.
'tatastasmindvijaSrezWa samudIrRe taTAviDe.' (BA0 Adi0 32.1). samudIrRe devAnIke saNgrAmAyodgate.

'udaDAviva sarvasinDavaH samudIrRAstvayi nATa dfzwayaH. na ca tAsu BavAn pradfSyate praviBaktAsu saritsvivodaDiH' (syAdvAda0 30 ityatra hEmodDftaM sidDasenadivAkaravacanam). samudIrRAH saNgatAH. ucCabdastvasTAne.
'divodAsAya navatiM ca navendraH puro vyErayacCambarasya' (f0 2.19.6). vyErayat vyagamayat. vyaDvaMsadityarTaH.
'treDA sahasraM vi tadErayeTAm' (tE0 saM0 7.1.6.27). tad gavAM sahasraM viBaktavantO, viBajya vyavasTApitavantO prAptavantO.
'dyumnavad brahma kuSikAsa erira eka eko dame agniM samIDire' (f0 3.29.15). erire=A Irire. udIrayAmAsurityarTaH.
'utAdaH paruze gavi sUraScakraM hiraRyayaM nyErayadraTItamaH' (f0 6.56.3). nyErayat prErayat prARudat.
'ye tve kAmaM nyerire' (f0 8.19.18). nyerire nitarAM prerayanti.
'yaM devA dUtamaratiM nyerire' (f0 8.19.21). nyerire prerayanti prasTApayanti visfjanti.
'udagne Sucayastava SukrA BrAjanta Irate' (f0 8.44.17). udIrate uccaranti.
'udasya ketavo divi SukrA BrAjanta Irate' (aTarva0 13.2.1). udIrate utpatanti.
'udIratAmavara ut parAsa unmaDyamAH pitaraH somyAsaH' (f0 10.15.1). ukto'rTaH.
'udIrayetAM brAhmARi divyAnyastrARyanekaSaH' (BA0 droRa0 192.31) udIrayetAm prAkzipetAm. AqaBAvaSCAndasaH. CandovatkavayaH kurvanti.
'brahma kzatreRa saMsfzwaM kzatraM ca brahmaRA saha. udIrRe dahataH SatrUn vanAnIvAgnimAruto' (BA0 vana0 26.10). udIrRe pravfdDe.
'sa hi devErudIrRasya rAvaRasya vaDArTiBiH' (rA0 2.1.7). udIrRasya dfptasya.
'agnirvA ito vfzwimudIrayati' (tE0 saM0 2.4.10.2). udIrayati UrDvaM gamayati (AhutiBiH). vfzwimudakam.
'loBAt kroDaH praBavati paradozErudIryate' (BA0 SAM0 163.7). udIryata uddIpyate.
'sarvaM tu duHKaM mama lakzmaRedaM SAntaM SarIre vanametya SUnyam. sItAviyogAtpunarapyudIrRam' (rA0 3.63.6).. udIrRamutTitam.
'samutpapAtATa sadasyudIrito dvijAtimuKyarhavizeva pAvakaH' (rA0 5.57.2). udIritaH prerita uddIptaH.
